jobs.title: Senior Engineer, HMS Simulation Framework (R6058)
jobs.description_text: Job Description: As a Simulation Framework Engineer on the Simulation Framework Team, you will write the C++ and Python code, design adapters, and build custom plugins for our modeling and simulation (M&S) environments and core autonomy software. Your work is hands-on and technical, creating reusable, robust software patterns that abstract simulation details away from the core autonomy stack. Rather than managing teams, you will focus on the hands-on execution of migrating HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF—building baseline adapters, porting custom modules, and ensuring functional parity—while maintaining active support and backward compatibility for programs currently relying on HMSSimBlocks.

jobs.description_text: Job Description: As a Environmental Test Technician at Shield AI, you'll prepare, execute, and manage environmental tests on electronic flight hardware across the VBAT and XBAT aircraft, ensuring it meets performance requirements through rigorous thermal, vibration, shock, humidity, and altitude testing. This is a highly hands-on role. Working with design and reliability stakeholders, you'll help define test plans — stress profiles, setup, and instrumentation — then bring them to the bench: installing test articles, instrumenting hardware with thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and humidity sensors, configuring data acquisition, and programming and loading chambers. You'll frequently run several campaigns at once, prioritizing tests as needed to keep them moving without compromising data quality. Once tests are running, you'll operate the equipment, monitor for and investigate failures, and reduce and document results in clear reports — including the plots and visualizations stakeholders rely on to make disposition and qualification decisions. You'll work with cutting-edge deep-tech hardware, collaborate across disciplines, and directly influence product quality and long-term reliability over the vehicles’ lifecycles.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, LRV Systems (R6242)
jobs.description_text: Job Description: As a Staff Systems Engineer on Shield AI's next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating the Launch & Recovery Vehicle (LRV), the system that transports, deploys, launches, and recovers our autonomous aircraft in a variety of environments. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, hydraulics, electrical power distribution, navigation, and the mechanical, electrical, and data interfaces to the aircraft. You will work with the air vehicle’s propulsion, hardware, software, flight operations, and manufacturing teams to deliver a mobile, mission-ready LRV that works as part of the full UAS platform. You will also help shape how the system is transported, emplaced, and operated in the field. That means developing CONOPs that set deployment timelines, crew roles, logistics footprint, and how the system survives in the field.

jobs.description_text: Job Description: The Staff Data & Analytics Engineer, Domain Enablement is a senior, hands-on role responsible for enabling complex business domains on Shield AI’s enterprise data platform. This person will lead discovery, scope high-value data and analytics opportunities, and deliver governed data products that make operational data more usable, trustworthy, and scalable for business decision-making. The role works across the data stack—from understanding source systems and defining integration needs through transformation, modeling, semantic design, quality controls, documentation, and business consumption. jobs.description_text: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.description_text: EggAI Banking transformation programme (UK) Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks About the Programme EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production. EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers. The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems. The Role Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold. The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Responsibilities Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation. Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance. Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

Ter versterking van ons Content Team zijn we per 1 Februari 2027 op zoek naar een stagiair(e) Copy & Content Marketing (meewerkstage). Tijdens deze stage loop je mee op de afdeling Copy & Content Marketing. Jij helpt mee online content te creëren voor onze merken Sunweb en Eliza was Here. Zo leer je en draag je bij aan merkreputatie, klantenbinding, aansprekende copy voor verschillende communicatiekanalen en de verkoop van vakanties. Startdatum: Februari Jouw impact Bij jou begint de vakantiebeleving van onze klanten! Wij begeleiden je bij het schrijven van pakkende teksten voor onze kanalen (o.a. paid social, nieuwsbrieven) en je werkt en leert in een internationaal contentteam van 15 collega’s uit heel Europa. Als stagiair(e) Copy & Content Marketing ondersteun je het team en ga jij o.a. aan de slag met: Schrijven en optimaliseren van copy voor interne afdelingen en diverse vraagstukken, zoals: Promotiemateriaal op vakantiebestemmingen Paid social posts voor campagnes SEA-copy die scoort in zoekmachines Doorvertalen van marketingcampagnes naar verschillende kanalen. Creëren van pakkende copy voor nieuwsbrieven en geautomatiseerde mailcampagnes. Waarom stage lopen bij Sunweb Group? ✔️ Maandelijkse stagevergoeding van € 500,- (op basis van fulltime stage) ✔️ Jong, ambitieus en supergezellig team waar je volop kunt groeien en leren ✔️ Hybride werken: 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor – maar je bent altijd welkom voor extra kantoorda

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description_text: About Shiftbase We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way. We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro. About the role You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. jobs.description_text: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Since 2009, we’ve been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. From ideation to delivery, you’ll own the AI product roadmap, making sure every product we launch creates measurable value, drives innovation, and is grounded in real-world usability. Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to deliver AI-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, engagement, and outcomes. jobs.title: Freelancer UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer)
jobs.description_text: UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer) Location: Amsterdam, NL (beautiful office right near Leidseplein) Work Structure: Hybrid (4 days on-site, 1 day flexible remote) Experience Level: 2–4 years Type: Freelancer About Creative Clicks At Creative Clicks, we move fast, think big, and drive results. As a global leader in data-driven performance marketing, we combine high-impact user experiences with sharp creative to scale brands across continents. Our culture is built on our Triple E philosophy: Energy, Entrepreneurship, and Expertise . We operate with a vibrant, agile startup mentality and no corporate red tape. If you have an idea, you test it. If you see a friction point in a user journey, you fix it. We are expanding our Amsterdam headquarters and looking for a designer who ships: a UX/UI Designer who takes their own work from Figma all the way to a live Next.js production site. The Role This is not a classic handoff role. You design the experience and you publish it. Your Figma file becomes a live page because you built it, in Next.js, often the same week. Day to day you will design and ship high-converting landing pages, onboarding quiz funnels, and lifecycle emails; manage the websites they live on; and keep improving them with CRO experiments. AI-assisted building ("vibe coding" with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or v0) is core to how this role works, not a side experiment. You will touch several verticals and own things end to end: design, build, CMS, tracking, iteration.
